name: Olhobrasa
design: An adult fire-serpent demon, no limbs, striking compact upright S coil supported on its wide lower coil. Huge broad triangular cobra head, short snout, sharp vivid cyan eyes. Body made of large continuous vermilion and charcoal living kite membranes, cream underside, a single bamboo-like dorsal support line. Three enormous eye-shaped pale yellow flame sails along back, physically rooted in body, their slitted cyan centers repeat the real eye. Tail splits into two flowing burning kite ribbons. Expression vigilant and predatory. Bold asymmetrical S silhouette; no wings, no arms, no small scales. Fire is simple solid graphic tongues, not glowing painted particles.

name: Ferrabruma
design: An adult headless mule demon with four hooved legs, powerful enormous front hooves and high round shoulders, compact narrow hindquarters, distinctly equine quadruped anatomy. The thick neck ends in a smooth sealed charcoal kite collar, from it rises a giant cobalt blue and pale mint papery flame plume, with NO head and NO eyes in the flame. Elegant intimidating galloping turn, all four legs individually legible. Matte deep plum body and broad ivory tensioned paper chest, teal bamboo-like braces integrated around fetlocks, two long pale blue ribbon tails. Hooves shaped like split iron kite spools with one copper band each. Flame collar and ankles define a unique silhouette; no gore, no saddle, no rider, no face.

name: Cucavessa
design: An adult cunning crocodilian nightmare demon, bizarre creature anatomy not a person or witch in costume. Enormous angular hinged crocodile jaws and narrow magenta eyes, a tiny tucked torso, two gigantic folded rear haunches supporting a low crouch, two short delicate claw forelimbs dangling under jaws. Its sweeping crescent back sail doubles as a folded sleeping kite canopy, deep forest green with broad cream and lilac moon-shaped panels, bamboo ribs terminating at the hips. Long broad flat tail curls forward around feet like a quilted kite blanket. Only 3 large violet head frills forming a swept-back crooked silhouette; no hat, no staff, no clothes. Clever unsettling grin with only four large clearly placed teeth. Dark green, sage cream and muted purple flat masses.

name: Mapingorja
design: An adult enormous sloth-like forest demon with completely nonhuman body proportions, one small head sunk between huge shoulders, one vivid violet cyclops eye, tiny closed upper mouth. Huge squat diamond-shaped torso is a living dark burgundy kite membrane with a gigantic vertical belly mouth: two broad ivory folding lips and six simple blunt triangular teeth, stylized clean and non-gory. Two impossibly long heavy arms knuckle-walking outward with three thick hooked claws each, two short broad backward-pointing feet clearly planted under belly. Three oversized moss-green folded paper fur layers along shoulders and back, few very large tufts. Cream spine support spars stretch the belly kite-mouth at its corners; plum knot joints, a very short two-strip tail visible behind one hip. Adult threatening bulk, low action stance about to inhale wind through belly. No human muscular torso, no armor suit, no fur texture, no extra eyes or mouths.
